summary: Join our comprehensive training on Project Cycle Management for NGOs. Equip yourself with the tools to successfully manage and deliver impactful projects.
lede: Project Cycle Management for NGOs provides a structured way to move from verified needs and stakeholder analysis through planning, implementation, monitoring, evaluation, and closure. You will practise Theory of Change development, Logical Framework Approach design, indicator selection, budget monitoring, risk escalation, safeguarding integration, and learning capture. The course helps you turn project information into practical evidence through a concept note, logframe, results measurement plan, risk register, and donor progress report. You will also build activity schedules, responsibility matrices, monitoring dashboards using Excel or Power BI, and action plans that connect inputs to outcomes while supporting clearer reporting and responsible resource use.
audienceIntro: This course suits NGO professionals who coordinate the full project cycle or contribute specialist inputs to design, delivery, accountability, monitoring, evaluation, and donor reporting. It is appropriate for experienced practitioners who want a stronger end-to-end method and for technical specialists moving into project leadership.
prerequisites: You should have practical experience in NGO project delivery, programme support, grants, monitoring and evaluation, finance, partnerships, or humanitarian operations. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with project proposals, budgets, donor reporting, or field monitoring will help you apply the exercises effectively.
